title: Lemon Posset
description: A classical British posset — rich double cream simmered with caster sugar and set with fresh lemon juice. Silky and tangy.

ingredients.text: 2 x 284ml cartons of double cream (568ml total)

steps: Place 6 serving glasses or ramekins in the fridge to chill.
Put the cream and sugar in a saucepan and bring to the boil slowly, whisking. Simmer for 2–3 minutes until the mixture turns rich yellow.
Grate the zest from all 3 lemons; squeeze the juice from 2. Add the juice and two-thirds of the zest to the cream, whisking until smooth.
Pour into the serving dishes and scatter remaining zest on top.
Chill in the fridge for at least 3 hours before serving.
notes: Makes 6 possets. Serve with a ginger biscuit or shortbread round on the side.
